summary: This clinical trial compares two different medicine approaches to lower cholesterol and prevent heart and blood vessel problems in older adults with type 2 diabetes. The study looks at adults aged 70 years or older who have not had a previous heart attack, stroke, or other major cardiovascular event. Researchers want to see how a standard statin medicine compares to a tailored therapy plan that aims for specific cholesterol goals. A total of 2186 participants are taking part in this research.
